name: Edisto Beach
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Edisto Beach?
answer_short: Yes. In Edisto Beach, permitted golf carts may use every town road except Palmetto Boulevard (SC 174), which they may only cross straight over. LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less.

golf_cart.roads: All town roads except Palmetto Blvd

rules.rule: Every road in town limits except Palmetto Blvd (SC 174); cross straight over
Permitted, insured golf carts on secondary roads posted 35 mph or less, in daylight, within 4 miles of the registration address

banned_roads.name: Palmetto Boulevard (SC 174)
banned_roads.rule: No golf carts; cross straight over

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Palmetto Boulevard?
faq.a: No. It's a primary highway (SC 174); golf carts may only cross it straight over.

faq.q: Can I drive an LSV on Palmetto Boulevard?
faq.a: Where it's posted 35 mph or less, yes.
